description: Build a polished LinkedIn About section from your role, skills and achievements.

faqs.a: Enter your role, years of experience, skills and achievements — the tool assembles a first-person About section with a hook, story and CTA.
Professional, friendly or bold — each changes the voice of the generated summary.
The About section allows 2,600 characters; the generator keeps output well under that and shows the count.
Click Copy Summary and paste it into the About section of your LinkedIn profile.
faqs.q: How do I use the result?

howto: Enter your current role and industry.
Add years of experience, top skills and achievements.
Generate, review, and copy into LinkedIn.
title: LinkedIn Summary Generator
